fields.System.Title: OUT-105 — Accept orders from the ERP
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want orders to arrive from the ERP automatically, so that
nobody retypes them and nothing is missed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid ERP order message, then an order is created.
  • - Given the same message replayed, then exactly one order exists — enforced by a unique
  • constraint on (source_system, external_reference).
  • - Given an invalid message, then it is rejected with a reason and stored in the
  • dead-letter table with its original payload.
  • - Given an ERP cancellation message, then it runs the same cancel path as
  • [OUT-104](OUT-104-cancel-order.md).
  • - Given an ERP amendment for an unallocated order, then it is applied.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, platform |
| Tables | order, order_line, dead-letter |
| Risks | ERP retry creating a duplicate order and double shipment ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
